serverhelp: Required server help with guides, commands and information for the player.
multibot: Required interface to control and organise the server's bots.
playerbotmanager: Recommended gear, GearScore and raid composition management for your playerbot list. It complements MultiBot; it does not replace it.
guildlevels: Shows the guild experience, level and perks of mod-guild-levels. It syncs by itself, through whispers from the server; without it guild progression still works but without a visual panel.
questradar: Shows the location of quest objectives on the minimap, something this client does not include by default. Read-only over the game's own quest data; it needs no server module.
ackisrecipelist: Ackis Recipe List is an addon that scans your trade skills and provides information on how to obtain recipes.
acp: Stop logging out of the game just to change your addons! ACP adds an 'Addons' button to the game's main menu to enable/disable addons.
actionbarsaver: A quick little mod that lets you set up different profiles for your action bars. Mainly for hybrid classes who want to change specialisation without spending 10-20 minutes rebuilding their bars. All you have to do is type /abs save name and it stores the position of all your spells, macros and items, and /abs restore name to bring them back.
addemote: Ever wished World of Warcraft had more emotes? Or wanted to create your own emotes to use like the normal ones? Now you can! AddEmote lets you easily create new /command emotes for all your characters. Use /addemote for the settings interface.
addfriend: AddFriend is a simple addon that adds an Add Friend or Add Guild option to the player's context menu.
adibags: AdiBags is an addon that shows the contents of your bags in a single view, laid out in several sections using smart filters.
afflicted: Afflicted is an enemy spell timer mod for PvP (mainly arenas). It is for people who just want useful information, such as an interrupt being on cooldown so it is safe to cast a heal, or Blessing of Freedom becoming available again for an enemy Paladin soon.
allstats: This addon moves the functionality of the stats drop-down menus into a panel on the right side of the paper doll, so you can see all your stats at once.
altoholic: Altoholic features a search function that lets users search the bags of their alts or the loot tables in a frame similar to the Auction House.
amilockedout: AmILockedOut: a small addon that saves me a lot of time with all my alts. It remembers which of your characters are saved to which instance.
atlas: Atlas is an addon for World of Warcraft that provides maps for every instance, along with boss tips and information about their loot in the game.
atlasloot: AtlasLoot Enhanced is an interface mod that lets you look up boss loot tables whenever you need to, inside the game.
auctionator-watchlist: Adds price and item watch lists to Auctionator.
auctionator: Auctionator is designed for casual, everyday auction house users. It makes the auction house easier to use by presenting auction listings clearly and concisely, and by removing the tedious task of posting and managing auctions. This version uses a little less memory than the MoP version.
auctionator-completo: Full version of Auctionator to manage purchases, sales and searches in the auction house.
autoflood: AutoFlood periodically sends a one-line message to a chat channel. It is meant for advertising guild recruitment, crafting services, in-game events...
autoinvite: Used to automatically invite players to a group/raid depending on what they say and where they say certain 'trigger' keywords. To open the interface, type /ai or /autoinvite
autorepair: Automatically repairs all items when a merchant window is opened.
bartender4: Bartender4 is a complete action bar replacement mod. It gives you all the features needed to fully customise most aspects of your action bars and related bars.
bindpad: BindPad is an addon for creating key bindings for spells, items and macros. You no longer need action bar slots just to bind keys for your macros, etc. BindPad provides many icon slots in its frame. You can drag and drop anything onto one of these slots, and click the slot to set the key bindings.
blizzmove: This addon makes Blizzard's windows movable.
blt: BLT Raid Cooldowns tracks raid cooldowns (offensive and defensive), announces casts and availability, and provides a report on cooldown usage after boss fights. My version can show trinket cooldowns as intended; the addon's developer is no longer updating it.
bnettoast: BattleNET-style online/offline indicator for your friends/guildmates.
bugsack: BugSack makes viewing errors easier. It shows the Lua errors that occurred during your game session, including the full debug stack. It aims to be invaluable for developers and a useful tool for players.
carbonite: Carbonite is a Google-style map replacement and Questhelper for the World of Warcraft world.
cartographer: Cartographer is a modular, lightweight and efficient framework for manipulating the world map.
chatfilter: A simple addon just for me, to make Icecrown's /global chat more readable. It turned out quite good and useful for me, so I decided to share it with the community. If you are tired of being recruited by Persian guilds, or frustrated by endless /y messages like Il No'throma N O O O O L N Zaga maza'rotha Nogah mog NO o A, this addon lets you skip messages containing blacklisted words entirely. You can edit this list directly in the game. Filters apply to /y, /s and global channels.
chatter: Chatter is a complete, lightweight and mega-configurable chat enhancement addon. It supports lots of things, including.
cheese: Cheese simulates the proc display introduced with Cataclysm.
classloot: This addon is an in-game representation of the Class Loot Lists as tooltip information. Kaliban's Class Loot List provides ratings for all raid loot regarding its suitability for different class/specialisation combinations.
cleanminimap: A clean, square or round minimap that replaces the default minimap.
clique: Clique is a simple addon that enables powerful click-casting and hover-casting on your unit frames and in the 3D game world. You can assign practically any mouse or keyboard combination to a spell or macro. In its normal setup this lets you use the bindings on your unit frames to cast spells directly at that unit. This lets you choose both the spell to cast and the spell's target more quickly, without requiring an extra click.
collectinator: Collectinator is an addon to identify missing non-combat pets and mounts, along with where to get them. Open your companion window (pets or mounts) and click the scan button.
colorpickeradvanced: Advanced Color Picker: a better version of WoW's colour picker that includes class colour templates and a copy-and-paste function.
cooldowns: A World of Warcraft addon that shows numeric cooldown counters on all buttons that are 28 pixels wide or more.
critline: Critline is an addon that remembers your highest hits and crits (including heals and pet attacks) and shows them in a fairly simple tooltip. It has many features by default, including advanced filtering, a standalone frame, a visual effect on achieving a new record and more.
cromulent: Shows ZoneInfo on the world map in a perfectly cromulent way, Cartographer style.
dbm: Deadly Boss Mods (DBM) is a popular addon that helps players track and react to the many boss mechanics found during a dungeon or raid.
decursive: Decursive is a cleansing mod meant to make removing afflictions easy, effective and fun for all classes that have this ability.
details: Skada and Details! are both popular damage meters in World of Warcraft, each with distinctive features. Skada has a modular design, is more efficient and has more additional modules than Details!. Details! Damage Meter stands out for its easy-to-use interface and a complete set of tracking modules and graphs, improving combat data analysis for players. Skada is the best choice for better performance. Please use only one damage meter.
docscorporeality-r3: Helper for Phase 3 of Halion in the Ruby Sanctum.
dominos: Dominos is an addon that replaces your main bar with movable pieces that offer additional customisation. Dominos is mainly used for its action bars.
drdamage: DrDamage shows the calculated damage or healing of abilities, with talents, gear and buffs included, on your action bar buttons. The addon also adds several stats to the tooltips in your spellbook and on the action bar.
dressme: DressMe is an addon that lets you preview the appearance of items and create and save your character's looks.
elvui: ElvUI is a complete replacement of Blizzard's interface. This means you already get skinned Blizzard frames, pre-designed unit frames and action bars, etc.
ensidiafails: Detects and reports avoidable player mistakes during raid encounters.
eventhorizon: EventHorizon shows all of your class/specialisation's rotation abilities on a common timeline. This means that, instead of looking at a percentage-based timer bar, EH shows you exactly what is happening in relation to everything else. If that sounds complicated, just look at the screenshots.
everyquest: EveryQuest is a quest history tracker and quest list window.
fortexorcist: ForteXorcist is a powerful addon for cross-dotting that lets you keep track of every DoT you applied. It has many more features for Warlocks and Priests.
friendshare: Share your friends and ignore lists account-wide.
gatherer-wowhead335: The addon does not track the way a tracking ability does, but 'remembers' where you have found various items in the past. It does this every time you gather (herbalism, mining or opening) an item, and records the specific location on the map in its history. Usage: /gather
gearscore: Lets you easily see the calculated GearScore of yourself and other players. It adds a weighted value for each item a player has equipped, based on Item Level. GearScoreLite: Reborn is the latest version of the addon and is based on the final official GearScoreLite from CurseForge. It has no database, has an improved GearScore algorithm, includes several bug fixes and new features, and is compatible with all unit frame addons.
gearscorelite: Lets you easily see the calculated GearScore of yourself and other players. It adds a weighted value for each item a player has equipped, based on Item Level. GearScoreLite: Reborn is the latest version of the addon and is based on the final official GearScoreLite from CurseForge. It has no database, has an improved GearScore algorithm, includes several bug fixes and new features, and is compatible with all unit frame addons.
gladiusex: The famous (and in my opinion far superior) arena frames addon GladiusEx. Gladius adds enemy unit frames to arenas to make targeting and focusing easier. It is highly configurable and you can disable most of this addon's features.
grid2: Grid2 is a unit frame addon for parties/raids.
gtfo: GTFO provides an audible alert when you are standing in something you are not supposed to stand in. In some cases you are warned before you start taking damage. This mod improves your situational awareness and is recommended for dungeon-goers and raiders of all skill levels, since even the most seasoned veteran sometimes needs a reminder to GTFO.
halionhelper: Provides a clearer display of the Corporeality buff during phase 3 of the Halion encounter in the Ruby Sanctum. Similar to the PvP capture frame, it lets you easily see whether you should be doing more, less or the same DPS.
healbot: A support addon for healers, as it can perform numerous small, useful tricks.
ignoremore: IgnoreMore lets you ignore more than 49 players, share the same ignore list, see when someone was ignored and the reason why the person was ignored.
inspectequip: InspectEquip attaches a panel to the inspect window that shows a list of the character's gear sorted by source (i.e. Raid, Vendor, Crafted...). This gives you a quick overview of a character's gear.
interruptbar: An addon that tracks enemy interrupt abilities in a small, tidy bar.
keybindingsprofiler: This addon lets you save key setups in different profiles; these profiles can be loaded and used again later. Each profile can be assigned to a specialisation so it loads automatically when switching specialisation. Accessible through /kbp help
kru: This addon was part of [KPack](https://github.com/bkader/KPack); it was extracted and turned into a standalone addon after a few requests. It contains 8 very useful modules.
losecontrol: LoseControl makes it easy to see the duration of crowd-control spells by showing them on a dedicated icon on the screen.
ludwig: Ludwig is a World of Warcraft item database addon that lets you search for any item inside the game. It lists every item in the game sorted by its properties and also lets you filter them.
macrobank: MacroBank is an addon that lets you easily create, organise and save macros for future use without first having to create them in the game's default macro window. It offers features such as categorising macros, editing text and icons, loading and replacing macros, and even sending macros to other MacroBank users.
magenuggets: Mage Nuggets is a utility with many handy nuggets to make Mages' lives easier.
mapster: Mapster is a very simple world map enhancement addon, designed to work alongside every other map addon out there.
marketwatcher: Records auction house prices and lets you check how they evolve.
merfinplus: A collection of sounds, voices, fonts and bars for LibSharedMedia-compatible addons.
mikscrollingbattletext: MSBT is designed to be an extremely lightweight, efficient and highly configurable mod that makes combat information easier to see by scrolling it across the screen in separate, dynamically creatable scroll areas. It is a replacement for Blizzard's Floating Combat Text and damage output.
mogit: MogIt is an in-game item catalogue aimed at helping players build their own sets for transmogrification purposes.
molinari: Molinari lets the player easily 'recover' items straight from the inventory by holding the Alt key and clicking the item in their bags, instead of dealing with the professions interface, the spellbook, macros or actions.
mopitemtooltips: MoP Item Tooltips is an addon that modifies item tooltips so they look like they do in later expansions.
needtoknow: NeedToKnow lets you monitor specific buffs, debuffs, cooldowns and totems as timer bars that always appear in a consistent place on your screen.
notplater-3-3-5: A feature-rich nameplate addon designed after the modern Plater addon. Its main purpose is to provide extensive threat information on nameplates with fully configurable options. You can access them through the minimap button or with the slash commands /np or /notplater.
omen: Omen is a threat meter. Basically, enemies in WoW decide whom to attack by determining who is the most threatening based on the abilities you use.
opie: OPie is a radial action binding addon for World of Warcraft. It lets you group actions into rings, which appear when you hold down a key or a mouse button. When you release the key or button, OPie performs an action based on the position of your mouse cursor.
outfitter: Lets you easily switch between gear sets; it works with DBM weaponswitch.
overachiever: Overachiever provides tools and settings to make life a little easier for players who chase achievements.
pallypower: Pally Power, the must-have for a Paladin, offers an interactive, easy-to-use interface that lets you set your own blessings (Righteous Fury, Aura, Seal and Blessings) and automatically checks for missing buffs with an easy-to-read indicator.
phoenixstyle: PhoenixStyle is a famous WoW addon that tracks many mistakes and other useful and interesting information about boss fights, and has some interesting things for raid leaders.
plagued: Encounter helper to manage plague mechanics and warnings during combat.
plugins: A collection of optional addons to extend and customise ElvUI.
pminimap: pMinimap is a very lightweight, simplified minimap addon.
postal: Postal offers improved mailbox support, providing many features. Improved by BlueAo, adding new features.
quartz: Quartz is a modular approach to a cast bar addon.
questhelper: Questhelper tells you how to complete your quests the easiest and fastest way. It includes a database of quests, monsters and items, telling you the exact location of that darned Perfect Satyr Horn you cannot find. It also calculates the fastest path to complete all your quests and gain experience as quickly as possible.
raidbrowser: Bringing LFR to Wotlk. This addon replaces the unused LFR tab (in 3.3.5a) in the social menu with a working raid browser. Use /rb to open.
raidbuffstatus: RBS reports on a configurable board or in group chat about consumables, buffs, AFK, mana and many other things, but in an automatic and smart way. RBS is the last nail in the coffin of all max-level raiders who slack off.
raidcomp: Raid composition is an important aspect of PvE in WoW. RC also helps raid leaders by providing an overview of the different categories of buffs and debuffs. It will not do all the thinking for you, as raid optimisation is complex, but it should be able to do most of the heavy lifting and highlight some of the categories and abilities you need to look at more closely.
raidroll: Raid Roll is an addon that can be used to perform a raid roll. A raid roll lists all players with an ID next to their name. It then makes a roll and announces who the winner is (based on the ID). You can also follow the rolls made by players over any loot that drops.
redeemer: This addon makes you say humorous messages every time you cast a resurrection spell and serves only to entertain you and annoy others.
rsa: RSA is an addon that can announce spell casts in several chat channels. There is a large selection of abilities for each class that RSA can announce, such as interrupts, defensive cooldowns and utility spells, for example Soulstone.
sexycooldown: SexyCooldown is a single, consolidated timer bar for all your spells, your pet's spells, items and proc cooldowns, as well as for buffs, debuffs and totem timers. It is very flexible and can be customised to fit into your user interface however you see fit.
sexymap: SexyMap completely redesigns your minimap to give it a 'sexier' look. You can choose from a couple of predefined styles.
shadowedunitframes: SUF gives you a modified interface that can show you, for example, which players are currently out of range or which of them have negative (or positive) auras. It also lets you move the individual character windows to wherever works best for you.
sharedmedia: Inserts media (fonts, bars, borders, etc.) into LibSharedMedia storage. They can then be selected by any addon that supports LibSharedMedia. bKader Shared Media for more bars, textures, fonts and sounds (popular version), with many custom things added. SharedMedia Retail for more bar textures and fonts (retail version). SharedMediaAdditionalFonts for more fonts. MerfinPlus adds predefined TTS, sounds, status bars, fonts and more.
skada: Skada and Details! are both popular damage meters in World of Warcraft, each with distinctive features. Skada has a modular design, is more efficient and has more additional modules than Details!. Details! Damage Meter stands out for its easy-to-use interface and a complete set of tracking modules and graphs, improving combat data analysis for players. Skada is the best choice for better performance. Please use only one damage meter.
smarttrack: Smart automatic tracking just for hunters with the Improved Tracking talent. Every time you enter combat, this addon checks your target's type (if any) and automatically changes your tracking accordingly. If you change target during combat, your tracking changes too (if your new target is of a different type and you can track it).
snowfallkeypress: This addon speeds up key bindings so they trigger on key press instead of key release. Do not use it with ElvUI!
soundalerter: SoundAlerter for WoW 3.3.5a - the addon announces with sound when the enemy uses important cooldowns, abilities, controls, defences and trinkets. In general, all your important actions in PvP.
spellid: Adds IDs to the game's tooltips.
spellreplay: SpellReplay is an addon originally created for Sbkzor to backport a retail addon widely used by streamers called TrufiGCD. The addon scrolls smoothly and speeds up when several spells are used at the same time, which makes it easy to highlight good plays.
spy: The Spy addon scans the combat log for actions performed by enemy players and announces their presence when they are detected. By warning you about nearby enemy players, you can prepare for possible PvP combat. If an enemy player is detected, Spy tries to determine their class, race and level based on the ability that was used. It then raises an alert and adds the enemy player to the Nearby list.
talented: Talented is a replacement for the default Talent user interface, with many added features.
tellmewhen: TellMeWhen is a WoW addon that provides visual, audible and text notifications about cooldowns, buffs and practically every other element of combat.
tidyplates: Tidy Plates improves World of Warcraft's nameplates. See aggro, health % and more on the nameplates.
tiptac: TipTac is a tooltip enhancement addon that lets you configure various aspects of the tooltip, such as where it is shown, the font, the tooltip scale, and many more things.
tradeskillmaster: TSM is an addon designed to help both casual gold makers and experienced goblins optimise their gold-making processes. TSM's features include everything from improving the native crafting and auction experiences to helping you gather the materials you need and take advantage of the bargains available in the auction house.
trufigcd: TrufiGCD is a small addon that shows the abilities last used by group or arena members. It can also be used to broadcast and show the last spell you used.
turnin-2-1: An addon that automates clicking through NPC quest and gossip dialogs. It automatically hands in repeatable or normal quests, accepts quests and selects the appropriate NPC options. You will never have to talk to an NPC again! To open the Options window, type /ti window.
vuhdo: VuhDo is a raid monitor with built-in raid frames. Basically, it is about showing the health of raid members in the form of clearly organised bars.
wim: WIM (WoW Instant Messenger) is a World of Warcraft addon that brings the feel of an instant messenger to in-game communication.
xct: xCT+ is a combat text replacement (like MSBT). Backported from retail Pandaria, this version, compared to other backports, offers control over settings inside the game and is more minimalist and anti-spam than MSBT
ratingbuster: Compares stats and shows in tooltips how much a piece of gear improves or worsens things.
savedinstances: Records the raid and dungeon lockouts of all your characters and when they reset, so you know at a glance what is left to do.
raidslackcheck: Before a raid boss, checks who is missing the potion, flask or raid buff and warns in raid chat. Operated with /rsc.
